about.bio1: Full Stack Developer with over 2 years of professional experience in developing and maintaining web applications and hospital information systems (HIS).
about.bio2: I mainly work on back-end development with <hl>PHP</hl> and <hl>Symfony</hl>, as well as front-end development with <hl>React.js</hl>. I also have experience building MERN applications, creating REST APIs and managing PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases.
about.tagline: I turn real needs into reliable applications.
about.bio3: My experience has allowed me to work on business applications, hospital data consolidation, Front-End / Back-End integration and performance optimization.
about.bio4: Rigorous, autonomous and highly adaptable, I want to keep growing in Full Stack development and contribute to concrete technical projects.

his.title: Hospital Information System (HIS)
his.description: Development and maintenance of an HIS used by several healthcare facilities to manage medical, administrative and hospital processes.
points: New features with PHP, Symfony and Mediboard
Development and maintenance of REST APIs
User interfaces with Smarty and Bootstrap
Business modules built with the functional teams
SQL query and PostgreSQL performance optimization
Corrective and evolutive maintenance, code reviews, Scrum

consolidation.title: Hospital data consolidation platform
consolidation.description: Platform that centralizes data from several healthcare facilities into a single database to ensure consistency, availability and reliability.
points: Services to extract, integrate and synchronize data coming from several HIS
Features built with Symfony, Doctrine ORM and React.js
PostgreSQL replication for high availability
Asynchronous processing (queuing) and extraction workload spread across Read Replicas
Deployment and maintenance on Docker and Ubuntu
